summary: Frontend-only UI testing of Expo wallet app. Home screen loads correctly with Saldo Totale €0,00, 4 bottom tabs render, quick-action buttons visible, section/transaction sheets open. Core single-flow works (Entrata +€100 updates balance to €100 and Entrate (mese) +€100). However discovered: (1) CRITICAL React Native SVG error on Analisi screen (Donut) — Invalid DOM property transform-origin; (2) Delete-section action in Sezioni tab appears to have NO testID / no delete affordance detected; (3) When reusing quickActions after the sheet was previously opened, selector ambiguity exists because 'Entrata'/'Uscita'/'Trasferisci' labels exist both on quick-action cards AND inside the sheet type-toggle, causing playwright .first to hit wrong element. Suggest adding stable testIDs on quick-action buttons (quick-action-income/expense/transfer already exist — need to prefer those in tests) AND distinct inner-sheet labels or testIDs for segment toggles.

ui_bugs.issue: React Native SVG prop uses 'transform-origin' (kebab-case) which is invalid DOM property on web. Causes red console error overlay on Analisi screen (line ~174). Must use 'transformOrigin' or remove the prop for web compatibility.

No delete-section button/testID found when scanning the Sezioni tab. The required flow 'deleting Risparmi moves balance back to Conto Principale' cannot be executed via UI. Verify a visible delete affordance (long-press, swipe, or trash button) with testID like 'delete-section-{id}' exists.

integration_issues.flow: Add Uscita after Add Entrata via quick actions
integration_issues.issue: During e2e test, the Uscita quick-action click was ambiguous due to duplicate 'Uscita' label (QuickActions card + inner segment toggle in open sheet). Result: expense flow effectively added +€30 instead of -€30. Needs unique accessible label or ensure sheet unmounts/hides from DOM when closed.

Same duplicate-text issue as above — 'Trasferisci' appears both on QuickActions and inside sheet segment. Transfer sheet never showed 'Alla sezione' selector during automated run; TO-SECTIONS was empty.

issues: Red Expo error overlay appears due to transform-origin prop; blocks visual QA

react_native_issues.issue: Invalid DOM property transform-origin — use camelCase transformOrigin to be web-compatible.
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Fix Donut SVG prop: change transform-origin to transformOrigin in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/analytics.tsx (around line 174) to remove red error overlay.

Add a delete-section control in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/sections.tsx with testID 'delete-section-{id}' (and a confirmation dialog with testID 'confirm-delete'). This flow is explicitly required by the problem statement.

Avoid duplicate accessible text between QuickActions card labels ('Entrata'/'Uscita'/'Trasferisci') and the segment toggle labels inside AddTransactionSheet. Options: (a) rename segment labels (e.g. keep 'Entrata/Uscita/Trasferimento') or rely only on testID selectors in tests; (b) ensure BottomSheet is fully unmounted when closed (index=-1) so inner labels aren't in DOM — currently they remain in DOM.
Migrate pointerEvents prop usages to style.pointerEvents to clear deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: store.ts: addTransaction allows negative balances silently (comment says 'won't block') — ok per spec but consider surface warning.

AddTransactionSheet: useImperativeHandle.open() correctly resets type/category/sectionId/toSectionId, but amount/note resets are correct too — logic is sound; issue is purely selector ambiguity + DOM persistence.
analytics.tsx Donut uses invalid web prop; test manually on web preview before shipping.
seed_data_creation: AsyncStorage/localStorage was cleared before testing; no seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed working: initial load, Home screen, bottom tabs, single Entrata flow (+€100 reflected in balance & month income), New Section creation (Risparmi with target 1000 + green color + icon), Movimenti filter chips exist (filter-all/income/expense/transfer). Not fully validated due to issues above: Uscita flow, Trasferisci flow, Analisi donut rendering, Delete section flow. Use quick-action-* testIDs explicitly, don't use text-based selectors due to duplicate labels.
rca_of_issue: transform-origin RCA: react-native-svg on web expects camelCase DOM-safe props; using kebab-case causes React to warn + Expo error overlay. Fix is a 1-line rename. Delete-section RCA: feature likely not yet implemented in Sezioni tab — no delete testID found during DOM scan.
